archetypes.name: stale-ref-sweep
archetypes.rationale: The plan lists 7 scope files but LARCH_SHIP_PR_IMPL/Phase-7/soak references may exist elsewhere in the repo; a missed surface is the primary partial-flip failure mode named in the plan itself.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the full repo for every reference to LARCH_SHIP_PR_IMPL, and for phrases 'default bash', 'LARCH_SHIP_PR_IMPL=python cutover', 'Phase 7', 'still uses bash', and 'during the soak' — not just the 7 plan-listed scope files. Check CI configs, other skill files, scripts/, release notes, and any .md files outside docs/. For each hit outside the plan's file list, assess whether it encodes the old bash-default or soak language that the flip should update. Verify that the plan's stated mitigation ('grep for Default is bash after the edit') is sufficient to surface all such sites, or name what it would miss. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: rollout-contract
archetypes.rationale: The plan unconditionally flips the default while acknowledging open soak blockers #3446/#3404/#3405/#3449 without providing a rollback instruction or operator guidance for python-path failures in the field.
archetypes.prompt_body: Assess the operator experience when the default silently flips for users who have never set LARCH_SHIP_PR_IMPL: check whether a changelog, release note, or upgrade-guide surface warns of the behavior change and documents LARCH_SHIP_PR_IMPL=bash as the escape hatch. Review whether docs/configuration-and-permissions.md (post-edit) explicitly advertises bash opt-out as a recovery mechanism for regressions from the acknowledged open soak blockers. Check whether the plan's acceptance criteria include any operator-facing guidance for diagnosing or recovering from a failed python-path Step 8+ run, and flag if that gap is left entirely to the soak-blocker issues without an interim mitigation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
